_comment: Main key cluster uses analog report 0x07. Dedicated media keys + digital dial on the V2 are separate (Consumer Control / non-optical) and typically never appear in driver-mode analog reports — skip them in calibrate with SPACE. Fn-layer media on Mini does not apply to V2 dedicated buttons.
